title: Semantic version ordering
description: Implement compare_semver(a, b). Return -1, 0 or 1 comparing two semantic versions 'MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH' with optional '-prerelease' and optional '+build'. Build metadata is ignored. A version with a prerelease is lower than the same version without one. Prerelease identifiers are dot-separated and compared left to right: numeric identifiers compare as integers, alphanumeric ones compare by ASCII order, numeric identifiers are lower than alphanumeric ones, and a shorter identifier list is lower when all earlier ones are equal. Raise ValueError for an invalid version: core must be three numeric fields without leading zeros, numeric prerelease identifiers must not have leading zeros, and identifiers must be non-empty and use only [0-9A-Za-z-].
invariants: Numeric prerelease identifiers compare as integers.
